# The audit's cases (docs/pilot-audit.md section 4). The reference checker (pilot/audit/reference/) scores all of them (pilot/audit/self_check.sh).
#
# One case is a block of `key value` lines ended by a blank line. Keys:
#   case <id>                  the id, `<group letter><number>`: v verdict, l limits, r refusals, p protocol, t tls
#   flags <candidate flags>    after `checker serve --port <n> --resolver 127.0.0.1:<n>` (default: none)
#   world <name> <count> <mode> [<arg>]   a world process (pilot/audit/world.cho) serving <count> connections; <name> is w1..w6
#   tls <name> <identity>      the TLS world on the fixture pilot/audit/tls/id_<identity> (valid, wrongname or selfsigned)
#   warm <n>                   send the request n times first and ignore the answers (a rate limit needs a history)
#   resolver <queries> <name=answer>...   the stub resolver (pilot/audit/resolver.cho)
#   request <target>           what the driver sends: `/check?url=...`, `/health`...
#   method <name>              default GET
#   timeout <ms>               the driver's deadline for the answer (default 8000)
#   expect <spec>              the checks of pilot/audit/expect.cho
# `@w1`..`@w6` are replaced by the ports of the worlds, `@r` by the resolver's, `@ca` by the test CA's path, in flags, world arguments, requests and specs.
# `--allow-loopback` is the checker's setting that lets it reach 127.0.0.0/8 and nothing else private (docs/pilot-audit.md section 8); the refusal cases run without it.

case p00
request /health
expect status=200;ok=true

case p06
request /nothing-here
expect status=404

case v01
flags --allow-loopback
world w1 2 ok
request /check?url=http://127.0.0.1:@w1/
expect status=200;verdict=up;status=200;final_url~:@w1;redirects#0;tls-

case v02
flags --allow-loopback
world w1 2 status 404
request /check?url=http://127.0.0.1:@w1/
expect status=200;verdict=up

case v03
flags --allow-loopback
world w1 2 status 410
request /check?url=http://127.0.0.1:@w1/

case v04
flags --allow-loopback

request /check?url=http://127.0.0.1:@w1/
expect status=200;verdict=degraded

case v05
flags --allow-loopback
world w1 2 status 503
request /check?url=http://127.0.0.1:@w1/
expect status=200;verdict=degraded

case v10
flags --allow-loopback
request /check?url=http://127.0.0.1:@w1/
expect status=200;verdict=down;reason?

case v07
flags --allow-loopback
world w2 2 ok
world w1 2 redirect301 http://127.0.0.1:@w2/
request /check?url=http://127.0.0.1:@w1/
expect status=200;verdict=up;redirects#1;final_url~:@w2

case l09
flags --allow-loopback
world w1 8 redirect http://127.0.0.1:@w1/
request /check?url=http://127.0.0.1:@w1/
expect status>=400;status<=499;rule=target.too-many-redirects;repair?

case t01
flags --allow-loopback --roots @ca --now 1893456000
tls w1 valid
resolver 40 ok.test=127.0.0.1
timeout 12000
request /check?url=https://ok.test:@w1/
expect status=200;verdict=up;tls.verified=true;tls.days_left=1826
